author: @sreeram-11

evidence.api_compatibility: Not breaking. Before this PR, /api/show returned 404 for an alias name; now it returns 200 with the target model's show data. Before this PR, /api/pull and /api/delete silently stripped ':latest' from an alias like '<target>:latest', acting on the target model instead of the alias — now they return 404. These are bug fixes, not breaking changes. The documentation note in docs/api/internal.md and src/cpp/server/routes/internal/aliases_list.cpp was corrected to reflect that Ollama's /api/show now resolves aliases (previously it said Ollama did not).
evidence.documentation: docs/api/internal.md and src/cpp/server/routes/internal/aliases_list.cpp were updated to reflect that Ollama's /api/show now resolves aliases (previously the note said Ollama and Anthropic gateways do not resolve aliases). The change is scoped to internal API docs; no user-facing guide changes are needed for this bug fix.
evidence.manual_release_testing: No evidence a human exercised /api/show with an alias, `ollama run <alias>`, an alias-named '<model>:latest' on pull/delete, or a registered ':latest' model on delete. CI passed all workflows (Lemonade App checks, Validate New llama.cpp Release, C++ Server Build/Test/Release), but the new Ollama alias behavior is user-facing and was only validated by unit tests.
evidence.post_approval_commits: The first (and only) approval was at 2026-11-15T00:17:40Z. There were zero commits after this approval, so no post-approval churn occurred. The four commits on the PR are: d69af54 (resolve aliases in /api/show), ca82ed5 (refuse aliases in pull/delete), b8e953e (keep registered ':latest' model name), and 4243efe (fix test cleanup and assertion — addressing CodeRabbit comments). The last commit predates the approval.
evidence.review: The only human review came from @fl0rianr, who approved with 'LGTM' on 2026-11-15T00:17:40Z. @fl0rianr's listed subject areas (docs/dev/contribute.md) are 'Lemonade Mix (LMX) omni models, GUI, ci, smart router' — not the Ollama gateway or model alias system. Two reviewers were requested (@iswaryaalex and @jeremyfowers) but neither submitted a review. The PR did receive automated comments from @coderabbitai[bot] on test_005b and test_005c cleanup scope and assertion correctness, which the author addressed in a follow-up commit (4243efe). No second human review with relevant domain expertise was obtained.
evidence.security: No security concerns detected. The changes are confined to model name resolution in the Ollama gateway and do not affect authentication, permissions, credential handling, network calls, or supply-chain dependencies.
evidence.tests: Three new tests added in test/test_ollama.py: test_005a_show_resolves_alias (verifies alias resolution on /api/show and 404 on /api/pull and /api/delete), test_005b_pull_and_delete_refuse_a_latest_alias (confirms an alias named '<model>:latest' cannot pull or delete the target), and test_005c_delete_a_registered_latest_name (confirms a real model whose name ends in ':latest' is deleted correctly). The PR description reports 38/38 tests passing on the branch. No tests were weakened or deleted.

maintainer_todos.text: Start the server with a model and register an alias to it via POST /internal/aliases, then POST /api/show with the alias name and confirm the response matches the target model's show output.
Run `ollama run <alias>` with the Ollama CLI and confirm the alias resolves to the target model and starts a chat, instead of returning 404.

Create an alias named '<some-model>:latest' pointing to a different model, then POST /api/pull and DELETE /api/delete with that alias and confirm both return 404 without touching the target model's files.
Register a model with the literal name '<model>:latest', then DELETE /api/delete with that name and confirm the ':latest' model is removed while the base model '<model>' remains.

subject: fix(ollama): resolve model aliases in /api/show (#4158)
summary: Resolves model aliases in Ollama's /api/show endpoint and prevents an alias ending in ':latest' from name-colliding with a different model on /api/pull and /api/delete.
verdict_reason: The only substantive review was an LGTM from @fl0rianr, whose listed expertise areas do not include the Ollama gateway, and the user-visible API changes were not manually exercised.
